distinct_unresolved_c_le_20.warum: The prime knots are enumerated up to AND INCLUDING c=20 (Thistlethwaite, Algebraic & Geometric Topology 25 (2025) 329-344; 1,847,319,428 items). These knots therefore lie in a COMPLETELY tabulated range — that we do not find them is a statement about our tables, not about the knots. The c=20 data are not public; Burton's census up to c=19 is here, the comparison against c=19 was still outstanding on 04.09.2026.
distinct_unresolved_c_le_20.schranke: TWO routes, the larger wins (field c_lower_bound_proven, provenance in c_lower_bound_via): span V(K) <= c (Kauffman-Murasugi-Thistlethwaite) AND c >= 2g+1 (Seifert algorithm, only with HFK-exact genus; genus route built in 2026-09-05 on Werner's go)
distinct_unresolved_c_le_20.werner: untere schranke = k 20. no novelty. (2026-09-04) · genus. (2026-09-05)

distinct_unresolved_alternating_c_le_24.rule: hyperbolic + no table hit + c >= 21 PROVEN, but alternating (or alternation undecided) at c <= 24
distinct_unresolved_alternating_c_le_24.warum: Disc #814, 20.09.2026. There are TWO enumeration limits, not one. All prime knots are enumerated up to c = 20 (Thistlethwaite 2025); the ALTERNATING ones, however, are published up to c = 23 (Rankin, Flint & Schermann, J. Knot Theory Ramif. 13 (2004) 57-150; 25,182,878,921 items at c=23, finished 14.03.2004) and computed up to c = 24 (Fontaine, Rankin & Flint 2007; OEIS A002864 a(24) = 128,564,665,125). Verbatim from Thistlethwaite himself, AGT 25 (2025) p. 2: "This has indeed been accomplished quite dramatically for n <= 23 [Rankin et al. 2004]." An alternating knot with c = 21..24 thus lies in an existing enumeration — that we do not find it is a statement about our tables (Hoste, Handbook: "not yet publicly available"), not about the knot. Same situation as unresolved_c_le_20.
distinct_unresolved_alternating_c_le_24.status: Field alternating_proven per record: True = alternating PROVEN (flag from Regina OR span V == c_ub by Kauffman-Murasugi-Thistlethwaite), None = undecided (span V == lower bound < c_ub). False never occurs here: proven non-alternating ones with c >= 21 are novel_hyperbolic.
